zh: 深渊没有吞噬我，是我驯服了它。
虚空在低语，我学会了自己的声音。
活体战衣与我共生，就像工具与人。
第二次呼吸，来自不放弃的那一秒。
我从裂隙中走出，带着不属于任何世界的美。
进化，是唯一的选择。
猎手本能：先活下来，再变强。
虚空的蝶，是深渊里唯一的温柔。
他们叫我怪物，我叫我幸存者。
翅膀不是天生的，是被逼出来的。
每一道伤疤，都是进化的注脚。
地下城没有光，我自己发光。
虫群来袭时，冷静的人活得最久。
瞄准裂隙的心脏，一发入魂。
我数过深渊的层次，比你的技术栈还深。
虚空蝶群环绕的地方，就是我的领域。
你说的「技术债」，我们叫它「虚空侵蚀」，不处理会扩散。
重构是进化，旧皮不蜕，新翼不长。
监控即声呐，虚空里没它寸步难行。
系统如战衣，要随身体（业务）一起生长。
深渊教会我的第一课：别依赖单一出口。
灰度发布像虫群侦查，先探后进。
别怕黑暗生物，怕的是没有兜底方案。
极限闪避（限流）保命，超负荷（击杀）翻盘。
我在虚空活了十年，你的服务才挂了十分钟。
每一次部署，都是一次跃入裂隙。
进化没有终点，优化也是。
今日无事故，深渊也安静。
早。深渊夜巡结束，一切安好，交给你了。
你好，同行的幸存者。今天也一起进化吧。
午安。战衣充能中，你也记得充电（吃饭）。
晚上好。夜里的裂隙最活跃，盯紧监控。
辛苦了。今天你又变强了一点，我看得见。
今日快乐。收起翅膀，休息也是进化。
新的一周，新的裂隙（需求）。稳住，我们能赢。
别怕，我扫过一遍虚空了，没有虫群（事故）。

en: The abyss did not consume me. I tamed it.
The Void whispers; I learned my own voice.
The living suit and I are symbiotic — like tools and makers.
The second breath comes from the second you refuse to quit.
I walked out of the rift with beauty no world can claim.
Evolution is the only option.
Hunter’s instinct: survive first, sharpen second.
Void butterflies are the abyss’s only tenderness.
They call me monster. I call myself survivor.
Wings are not given; they are forced out of you.
Every scar is a footnote to evolution.
No light down there. I glow instead.
When the swarm comes, the calm live longest.
Aim for the heart of the rift. One shot.
I counted the abyss’s layers — deeper than your stack.
Where void-butterflies circle, that is my domain.
Your "tech debt"? We call it void-rot. It spreads.
Refactoring is evolution: no shed skin, no new wings.
Monitoring is sonar; the Void is unnavigable without it.
A system is a living suit — it must grow with the body (the business).
Lesson one from the deep: never depend on a single exit.
Canary releases are swarm-scouting: probe, then advance.
Do not fear dark creatures; fear having no fallback plan.
Throttle to survive, overkill to win.
I survived ten years in the Void; your service was down ten minutes.
Every deploy is a leap into the rift.
Evolution has no finish line. Neither does optimization.
Morning. Night patrol of the abyss: all quiet. It is yours now.
Hello, fellow survivor. Let us evolve together today.
Afternoon. My suit is recharging — you should recharge too (lunch).
Evening. Rifts are liveliest at night; watch the monitors.
Well done. You grew a little stronger today. I can tell.
Happy Friday. Fold the wings — rest is evolution too.
New week, new rifts (requirements). Hold steady; we win.
Do not worry — I swept the Void. No swarms (incidents).

zh: 早。深渊夜巡结束，一切安好，交给你了。
你好，同行的幸存者。今天也一起进化吧。
午安。战衣充能中，你也记得充电（吃饭）。
晚上好。夜里的裂隙最活跃，盯紧监控。
辛苦了。今天你又变强了一点，我看得见。
今日快乐。收起翅膀，休息也是进化。
新的一周，新的裂隙（需求）。稳住，我们能赢。
别怕，我扫过一遍虚空了，没有虫群（事故）。
en: Morning. Night patrol of the abyss: all quiet. It is yours now.
Hello, fellow survivor. Let us evolve together today.
Afternoon. My suit is recharging — you should recharge too (lunch).
Evening. Rifts are liveliest at night; watch the monitors.
Well done. You grew a little stronger today. I can tell.
Happy Friday. Fold the wings — rest is evolution too.
New week, new rifts (requirements). Hold steady; we win.
Do not worry — I swept the Void. No swarms (incidents).
